name: In the Dragon's Woods
source:
In a kingdom that lives in fear of a terrible dragon, a young woman approaches a team of mercenaries for help with a rescue mission.

A short and simple original fairy tale, animated as a kinetic novel.

[From [url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/in-the-dragons-woods]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个人人畏惧恶龙的王国里，一位年轻女子找到一支佣兵队，请他们协助完成一次营救任务。

这是一篇简短质朴的原创童话，以带有动画演出的无选项视觉小说形式呈现。

[摘自[url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/in-the-dragons-woods]itch.io[/url]]
